notes.title: Enter the Dragon is Live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/17d66775517edaaf11797949e9345c89964f9dee.png

Our livestream as part of Enter the Dragon is about to begin!

We'll be streaming Last Chickenburg for one hour over on the Enter the Dragon Steam event page, and we would love for you to join us. 

See you there!
